all_missing_policy: User approved retaining naturally all-missing rows as an exception. Every other degraded row retains at least one originally observed pollutant.
augment_control: User approved three unchanged clean copies for A versus clean, moderate and severe copies for B; equal total training rows.
decision_rule: For EACH variant and protocol: helps iff mean severe macro-F1 difference B-A > sample SD of that paired difference AND mean clean accuracy difference B-A >= -0.01. No overall best-variant claim. CV fold summaries are descriptive, not seed SDs.
test_policy: Complete fixed CV before final held-out evaluation. No tuning or variant selection from held-out results.
optional_extensions: Neither compact sensitivity nor specialist comparison is part of the primary run. A descriptive subgroup diagnostic of repair-affected severe rows is prespecified.
